name: Gold-Analytics Clean-Rebuild -- thread gold-runners->ADVI/MDPF script-for-script, separate essential-vs-agnostic, rebuild lean
description: Andrew-direct 2026-06-24: the 49F gold analytics is an absolute mess (edge cases / patches / detours / accreted reconciliation debt), bulky + expensive (r6i.xlarge gold-runner, 17+ scripts incl. 26 E_* diagnostics). GOAL: a DEEP pipescript thread-analysis of EVERY path from the gold runners down to ADVI (+ MDPF) components, script-for-script, end-to-end -- identify what transformations ACTUALLY need to happen vs what's AGNOSTIC, and what's 49F-SPECIFIC overfit (the advisor ecosystem: architects/implementors/House/leaderboards/Lusha; the lots-FIFO reconstruction; the E_* diagnostic tail) -- then rebuild the analytics layer CLEAN against a canonical archetype, once and for all. Enabled by becoming-Black-Diamond (DATA_PLATFORM: we own the Schwab/custodian input). Archetype seed = Inflection (inf): snapshot-native, no advisor-overfit, the structurally-cleanest shape -- BUT Orion-sourced (different fields/layout), so the archetype is field-layout-AGNOSTIC (same analytics SHAPE, fed from whatever the custodian provides via the unified silver), with the advisor-ecosystem as a capability-declared EXTENSION not baked-in. Deliverables: A1 the end-to-end transformation ledger (every gold script -> output -> ADVI/MDPF consumer, tagged essential/agnostic/firm-specific/dead -- the thing nobody has ever had); A2 the essential-transformation spec; A3 the canonical firm-parameterized analytics archetype; A4 the clean rebuild (parity-gated firm-by-firm cutover). SIBLING of DATA_PLATFORM (one DATA macro): DATA_PLATFORM owns ingest/supplant -> clean unified SILVER; DATA_ANALYTICS owns gold-analytics -> served (off that silver). The seam = silver. DATA_PLATFORM's nascent D5 (unified gold engine) + D6 (MDPF/ADVI archetype) RE-HOME here (the dedicated analytics project operationalizes them as A3/A4); DATA_PLATFORM's reverse-ETL findings (BD-gold=mostly-repackaging; lots-FIFO=overfit; perf=self-owned-standard) are direct inputs to A1/A2.
